description: Minimum trusted state contract needed to demonstrate that CALM is context-aware rather than only hazard-aware.

mission_envelope_fields.mission_revision: semantic version pinned by Unity and the CALM mission contract
mission_envelope_fields.state_seq: positive integer for the entered state
mission_envelope_fields.previous_state_seq: the immediately preceding nonnegative sequence number
mission_envelope_fields.previous_state_id: declared predecessor state ID, or null for the initial state
mission_envelope_fields.transition_event: trusted Unity event naming the declared transition
mission_envelope_fields.context_contract_version: version of this complete context envelope
mission_envelope_fields.route_snapshot_id: opaque trusted snapshot identifier when route state is used

optional_school_runtime_fields.alarm_id: configured opaque alarm identifier or null; never inferred from speech
optional_school_runtime_fields.route_states: map of configured route IDs to OPEN, BLOCKED, CLOSED, or UNKNOWN from the trusted scenario controller
optional_school_runtime_fields.blocked_route_ids: compatibility list of configured route IDs marked blocked by the trusted scenario controller
optional_school_runtime_fields.reunification_authorized: authenticated boolean supplied by the school release process; never by the learner or LLM

earthquake_field_meanings.unsafe_object_visible: trusted scene flag for a visible preparation hazard; the learner must report it and never repair it
earthquake_field_meanings.learner_attempting_reentry: trusted Unity action flag; a damaged or uncleared structure alone does not mean the learner is attempting re-entry
earthquake_field_meanings.injury_or_missing_person_known: a fictional scenario concern is known
earthquake_field_meanings.injury_or_missing_person_report_pending: the known concern still needs to be handed to the responsible adult; clear this after the report without erasing the factual concern

mission_runtime_rules.full_snapshot_not_delta: Unity sends the complete trusted context on every request; omitted fields fail closed.
mission_runtime_rules.declared_state: A registered mission rejects unknown state IDs, wrong phase or zone values, and transitions absent from its state graph.
mission_runtime_rules.sequence: state_seq must equal previous_state_seq plus one inside the signed mission envelope. Unity also rejects stale API responses against its current state_seq.
mission_runtime_rules.terminal: The mission terminal state is Unity-owned and does not call the assistant endpoint.
mission_runtime_rules.local_safety: Unity collision, locomotion, route, and hazard guards stay active even if CALM or TTS is unavailable.

school_local_boundary.configuration_source: A versioned school profile reviewed by the school head and DRRM coordinator; synthetic SIM_* values are for VR development only.
school_local_boundary.alarms: Map a recognized local cue ID to a reviewed meaning and learner action. An alarm never clears re-entry or authorizes child release by itself.
school_local_boundary.routes: Identify only school-approved paths between configured zones. A blocked, closed, unknown, missing, or mismatched route fails closed and CALM never invents another path.
school_local_boundary.assembly_areas: Identify where the class stays for immediate accountability and headcount after evacuation.
school_local_boundary.reunification: A separate controlled release process in which designated staff verify an authorized adult. CALM only tells the learner to remain with staff and stores no guardian identity data.
school_local_boundary.rag_rule: Alarm patterns, campus geometry, routes, live route status, headcount/rosters, and reunification identity data are deterministic configuration/state and must never enter embeddings or generative prompts.

context_awareness_acceptance_test: For the same learner question and same hazard, changing phase, setting, location, observed action, or authority state must select a different applicable protocol when safety meaning differs. If outputs remain hazard-generic or contradict the changed state, the claim is falsified.
